title: When you don't understand
subtitle: No entiendo
review: Written by Claude in Latin American (Mexican) Spanish. Check the Spanish, the English and the notes before recording audio. English support only.

categories.desc: Saying that you are lost, and that you are still learning.
cards: The past: for what was just said.
Sorry, I didn't catch that. Can you repeat it?
Sorry, I don't speak much Spanish.
People slow down and smile when they hear this.
Hablo un poco. Estoy aprendiendo español.
I speak a little. I'm learning Spanish.

categories.desc: Asking someone to repeat, or to slow down.
cards: The polite Mexican 'what?'. ¿Qué? on its own sounds blunt.
— Can you pass me the…? — Pardon?
Neutral, and understood everywhere Spanish is spoken.
No entendí el precio. ¿Puede repetir, por favor?
I didn't catch the price. Can you repeat it, please?
Can you speak more slowly, please?

categories.desc: Questions about a word, and the moment it makes sense.
cards: How do you say 'receipt' in Spanish?
¿Cómo se dice…?: how do you say…?
How do you say 'receipt' in Spanish? — Recibo.
How do you spell your last name?
Oh, now I get it! Thanks.
